post.description:
Merge two models asynchronously.

Validates model existence, determines model type, and submits
merge job to the queue. The merged model will be saved to the
same checkpoint directory as the source models.

Args:
    request: MergeRequest with model_type, base_model, target_model,
             method, alpha, output_name, preserve_metadata

Returns:
    JobResponse with job_id, status, and message

Raises:
    HTTPException 404: If base_model or target_model not found

Merge base model with multiple target models in batch.

Creates a subdirectory for batch results and merges each
target model with the base model independently.

Args:
    request: BatchMergeRequest with model_type, base_model, target_models,
             method, alpha, output_subdir, preserve_metadata

Returns:
    JobResponse with job_id, status, and message

Raises:
    HTTPException 404: If base_model or any target_model not found

Execute a multi-step merge recipe.

Applies sequential merge operations following the recipe steps.
Each step merges the current result with a new target model.

Args:
    request: MergeRecipeRequest with model_type, base_model, steps,
             output_name

Returns:
    JobResponse with job_id, status, and message

Raises:
    HTTPException 404: If base_model or any step's target_model not found

post.description:
Download a Civitai file into the model directories as a background job.

Track it (progress, cancel) through /jobs/{job_id}. A base model that
doesn't match model_type answers 409 with warnings; resend with
accept_mismatch=true to download anyway.

get.description:
Which components a Flux checkpoint on Civitai bundles (transformer,
CLIP-L, T5-XXL, VAE), read from its safetensors header without
downloading it, and which shared components it would need from
flux.components_path that are missing there. Most Flux checkpoints need
an API key even for this.

post.description:
Look up a local model on Civitai by its SHA256 and, on a match, write
its .civitai.json sidecar (and preview). Hashing a large checkpoint
takes a while; the hash is kept in the sidecar so it's computed once.

FluxGenerationRequest.title: FluxGenerationRequest
FluxGenerationRequest.description:
Request for Flux image generation.

Flux uses flow-matching schedulers (incompatible with the SD/SDXL
scheduler set) and a distilled guidance scale, so scheduler validation
and the cfg_scale default are overridden; everything else is shared.
